description: Four digital oscillators taken from Mutable Instruments Edges, each with its own waveform, level and output

params.text: Sets the pitch of that oscillator, two and a half octaves either side of C4
Attenuates the voltage at that oscillator's MOD jack before it is added to the pitch, and inverts it below zero
Sets the level of that oscillator, 0 to 255
Steps that oscillator through the six waveforms in turn, and the lamp beside it shows which one by colour

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of that oscillator by a volt per octave; unpatched it reads the V/OCT jack of the oscillator before it, and the first oscillator reads 0V
Modulates the pitch of that oscillator, a full octave per 5V with the MOD knob wide open; unpatched it reads the MOD jack of the oscillator before it, and the first oscillator reads 5V

Scales the AMP knob by the voltage here, 10V leaving the knob untouched and 0V silencing the oscillator; unpatched it reads the AMP jack of the oscillator before it, and the first oscillator reads 10V

outputs.text: Carries that oscillator's wave, hard clipped at 5V, with the wave of any earlier oscillator whose own output is unpatched added in

notes: the four outputs are chained: an oscillator whose output is left unpatched is summed into the next output along, so patching only the fourth output gives a mix of all four
every jack is polyphonic, and the module runs as many channels as the widest cable patched into it
menu: Oscillator 1 Shape — picks the waveform of the first oscillator: Sine, Triangle, NES Triangle, Sample+Hold, LFSR Long or LFSR Short
Oscillator 2 Shape — picks the waveform of the second oscillator: Sine, Triangle, NES Triangle, Sample+Hold, LFSR Long or LFSR Short
Oscillator 3 Shape — picks the waveform of the third oscillator: Sine, Triangle, NES Triangle, Sample+Hold, LFSR Long or LFSR Short
Oscillator 4 Shape — picks the waveform of the fourth oscillator: Sine, Triangle, NES Triangle, Sample+Hold, LFSR Long or LFSR Short
